verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents an official hosted MCP server at https://use.jitsu.com/mcp. It uses OAuth 2.1 browser approval for interactive clients and personal API keys for headless/CI use. Agents can create destinations, wire streams, inspect Live Events and edit Functions, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of agents actually using the MCP server.
